_note: Copy only. The strictness ordering that the reconciliation math uses lives in code (puffpai.zone_bridge), not here, so editing this file can never loosen a posture.

postures.label: Open Yard
postures.summary: Everything you already said yes to happens without asking you again.

allows.lan_devices: Reaches any device you listed, with no prompt each time.
allows.actions: Actions that reach into the world run without a per-use prompt.
allows.egress: Outbound doors you switched on stay open while the bot runs.
allows.consent: Asked once, when you set it up, and not again at each use.

postures.costs: Nothing to click, but nothing to catch a mistake either. A wrong instruction reaches the world before you get a second chance to say no. Worth choosing on purpose, never by accident.

postures.label: Fenced
postures.summary: Your bot can talk to things in your house, and anything that reaches past it is gated.

allows.lan_devices: Devices on your own network are allowed.
allows.actions: Actions are gated at the boundary before they run.
allows.egress: Outbound doors are listed one by one and every one starts off.
allows.consent: Asked when an action would reach past what you already allowed.

postures.costs: You will be asked to confirm now and then. That is the trade for a bot that is useful in the house without being loose about the world outside it.

postures.label: Moat
postures.summary: Every outbound call and every action asks you first, every session.

allows.lan_devices: Allowed, but each reach asks you first.
allows.actions: Every action asks, every session. Nothing is remembered as pre-approved.
allows.egress: Every outbound call asks, even through a door you opened before.
allows.consent: Asked every time. Approval never carries over to the next session.

postures.costs: You will answer a lot of prompts. Good when the box is shared, when you are still learning what it does, or when you simply want to watch it work for a while.

postures.label: Drawbridge Up
postures.summary: Sealed. Nothing outbound, ever, and the bot says so plainly instead of failing quietly.

allows.lan_devices: Not reached. The bot works with what is already on the box.
allows.actions: Actions that would reach off the box do not run.
allows.egress: None. There are no doors to open.
allows.consent: Nothing to consent to, because nothing leaves.

postures.costs: Anything that needs the network is off the table, and the bot will tell you which things those are. This is the posture for a machine you want fully on its own.
